detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #26 Physical-output Packet Guard A raw frame can take a different path from an ordinary socket packet. PH4NTXM places a TC/eBPF guard at physical egress in Linux and Windows modes. It checks the configured interface and source MAC, validates marked IP layouts, and separately handles supported ARP, EAPOL, and DHCP traffic. Other unmarked frames are dropped. The guardian verifies classifier identity and filter layout. If repair is needed, it lowers the affected link, restores enforcement, and verifies the result before the permitted release. DHCP gets its own validation and normalization even when it already carries the worker's mark. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
